verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's own docs confirm that marketers can build automations and event-triggered flows, even on the free plan, and Composer can create flows. A community user describes easily setting up a winback-style "Haven't seen you in a while" email from tracked site events. However, nothing in the pack documents multi-step sequencing, conditional branches, time delays, or exit rules. Missing for 10: documented branching/conditional splits, delay steps, exit/stop rules, explicit welcome/onboarding series templates, hands-on corroboration of multi-step flow depth.
